# watchpoint_synthetic_monitor (Resource)

A synthetic (headless-browser) monitor that loads a page or runs a scripted flow, capturing screenshots, web vitals, and optional visual diffs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "watchpoint_synthetic_monitor" "example" {
  name        = "Checkout flow"
  start_url   = "https://app.example.com"
  script_type = "Playwright"
  script_json = jsonencode([
    { action = "navigate", url = "https://app.example.com" },
    { action = "assert_text", selector = "h1", value = "Welcome" },
  ])
  check_interval_seconds = 900
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable monitor name; shown across the UI and alerts.
- `start_url` (String) URL the browser navigates to first, including scheme.

### Optional

- `alert_profile_id` (String) Profile that controls notification channels and routing.
- `capture_har` (Boolean) Capture a HAR archive of network activity. Defaults to `false`.
- `capture_screenshot` (Boolean) Capture a screenshot on each run. Defaults to `true`.
- `check_interval_seconds` (Number) Seconds between checks. Defaults to `900`. Plans cap the minimum.
- `content_change_mode` (String) Content change detection: `off`, `record` (store a snapshot when the normalized body changes) or `alert` (also raise a Warning until the change is accepted in the portal). Defaults to `off`. Turning it on requires the content change detection feature.
- `content_ignore_regex` (String) Regular expression whose matches are removed before content is compared, for timestamps, nonces and similar noise. RE2 subset: no backreferences or lookaround.
- `disable_cache` (Boolean) Disable the browser cache for each run. Defaults to `false`.
- `enable_visual_diff` (Boolean) Compare screenshots against a baseline and alert on visual drift. Defaults to `false`.
- `environment_id` (String) Environment the monitor belongs to (a `watchpoint_environment` id). When omitted, a new monitor joins the tenant's default environment and an existing one keeps its environment. Reads return the effective environment, so a monitor that follows the default shows the default's id.
- `expected_texts` (String) Comma-separated text snippets that must be present on the page.
- `extra_headers` (String) JSON-encoded extra request headers map.
- `group_id` (String) Monitor group this monitor belongs to.
- `location_profile_id` (String) Profile that controls which regions run the check.
- `script_code` (String) Raw script source (for `Code` scripts).
- `script_json` (String) JSON-encoded recorded step definitions (for `Recorded` scripts).
- `script_type` (String) Script flavor: `SimpleUrl`, `Recorded`, or `Code`. Defaults to `SimpleUrl`.
- `sla_profile_id` (String) SLA profile attached to this monitor for uptime/latency SLO and error-budget tracking. Requires the SLA monitoring feature.
- `tags` (Set of String) Free-form tags surfaced in filters and SGL queries (`attributes.tags`). Unordered.
- `threshold_profile_id` (String) Profile that controls latency thresholds and consecutive-failure logic.
- `timeout_seconds` (Number) Run timeout in seconds. Defaults to `60`.
- `track_web_vitals` (Boolean) Collect Core Web Vitals (LCP/FID/CLS). Defaults to `true`.
- `user_agent` (String) Override the browser User-Agent header.
- `viewport_height` (Number) Browser viewport height in pixels. Defaults to `1080`.
- `viewport_width` (Number) Browser viewport width in pixels. Defaults to `1920`.
- `visual_diff_threshold` (Number) Percent of changed pixels that triggers a visual-diff failure. Defaults to `5.0`.
- `wait_for_selector` (String) CSS selector to wait for before considering the page loaded.
- `wait_for_selector_timeout_ms` (Number) Milliseconds to wait for `wait_for_selector` before failing. Defaults to `5000`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Monitor ID.
- `status` (String) Current monitor status (e.g. `Active`, `Paused`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_synthetic_monitor.example mon_synth_001
```
